questions.stem:
The basic scheme of the essential steps involved in the process of recombinant DNA technology is summarized below in the form of a flow diagram. Study the given flow diagram and answer the questions that follow.
Step-1 Vector DNA (cut using Restriction Enzyme EcoR I) + Alien DNA (cut using Restriction Enzyme EcoR I)
\(\downarrow\) Enzyme A
Step-2 Recombinant DNA molecule
\(\downarrow\)
Step-3 Transfer of recombinant DNA molecule in E. coli (Host)
\(\downarrow\)
Step-4 Replication of recombinant DNA molecule in E. coli
(a) Name the enzyme used in Step-1 to join the cut plasmid and alien DNA.
(b) State the technical term used for Step-3.
(c) Justify the use of same Restriction Enzyme EcoR I to cut both the vector DNA and the alien DNA.
questions._flag: Part (b) (half a mark) is transformation, under Cloning Vectors and Competent Host; the row is filed on Restriction Enzymes for parts (a) and (c).

(a) Name the covalent bonds depicted as (a) and (b) in the form of slanting lines in the diagram.
(b) How many purines are present in the given "stick" diagram ?
(c) Draw the chemical structure of the given polynucleotide chain of DNA.
questions._figure: REQUIRED:a 'stick' diagram of a three-nucleotide strand: three vertical sugar lines, each topped by a boxed base letter; a circled P at the left joined by a slanting line marked (a) to the 5' foot of the first sugar; slanting lines from the 3' position of each sugar to the 5' foot of the next, one of them marked (b); and a circled OH at the 3' end of the last sugar. The three base letters decide (b) and (c), so they are withheld here. Page idx 20.
questions._drawFigure: the chemical structure of the trinucleotide 5'-A-T-G-3' shown in the stick diagram: a 5' phosphate on the first deoxyribose, three deoxyribose sugars each carrying its base (adenine, thymine, guanine) on C1', the sugars joined by 3'-5' phosphodiester bonds through phosphate groups, and a free 3' hydroxyl on the last sugar; labels '5' phosphate', '3' hydroxyl', the phosphate groups, the sugars and the bases.

questions.context:
Deaths related to the use of drugs were estimated at about 5,00,000 in 2019, \(17{\cdot}5\) percent more than in 2009. Liver diseases attributed to Hepatitis B are a major cause of drug-related deaths, according to UNODC, accounting for more than half of the total number of deaths attributed to the use of drugs. Drug overdoses account for a quarter of drug-related deaths.
Opioids contribute to account for the most severe drug-related harm, including fatal overdoses, when used non-medically. At the global level, two-third of direct drug-related deaths are due to opioids, and in some sub-regions the proportion can be as high as three-quarters of such deaths.
